blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. wanted to answer more questions from reporters who attended his press conference following the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit, but had to leave the venue because United States (US) President Donald Trump was waiting for him. Toward the end of the press briefing on Tuesday at the International Media Center in Pasay City, Marcos was ushered off the stage by his staff but decided to answer one more question from a Filipino reporter.
